caption.en: Masked language modelling: about 15% of positions are selected; of those, 80% become [MASK], 10% a random token, 10% stay unchanged, and the loss is averaged over the selected set S only.
caption.fr: Modélisation de langage masquée : environ 15 % des positions sont choisies ; parmi elles 80 % deviennent [MASK], 10 % un jeton aléatoire, 10 % restent inchangées, et la perte est moyennée sur l'ensemble choisi S seulement.

caption.en: T5 span corruption on tokens 1..10 with spans (start 2, length 2) and (start 6, length 3): each span becomes one sentinel in the input, and the target lists the sentinels with the removed tokens, ending with a closing sentinel.
